about: Rockwood is a rural municipality north of Winnipeg, Manitoba, enclosing the separate towns of Stonewall and Teulon—not those towns, and not a city. Hamlets such as Stony Mountain, Balmoral, Gunton, and Argyle sit among Interlake farmland and limestone country. About 8,000 people live in Rockwood RM.
